summary: Frontend-only retest of the pageTranslator.js portal-scope fix (run() and initPageTranslator() now observe document.body instead of #root). Login as test@train.com / test123456 -> /dashboard?lng=en confirmed: (1) BASE PAGE in EN — the entire dashboard is translated (sidebar 'Training Plans / New Plan / Search plan…', empty state 'Select a Plan / Choose a training plan from the left panel to access its sections and data. / Create New Plan', top nav 'Dashboard / Data / Scouting / Report / Sessions / Alerts / Demo / Admin / Plan / Log out / EN', Control Panel widgets 'Readiness Score / Sleep quality / Muscle soreness / Stress / Motivation / Ready to train / Acute:Chronic Load Ratio / Optimal / Stable / Acute load (7d) / Chronic load (28d) / Active Plan / No plan selected / Click to select / My Plans / Athletes / Events / Sessions / Exercises / Adherence / Training Analysis / Interactive charts – Use the controls to explore / Volume, Intensity & Density / Live / Density % / Intensity % / Volume % / Intensity & Recovery / Recovery % / Phase Distribution / Accumulated Training Load / Upper Limit / Overtraining / Optimal zone', greeting 'Saturday, Jun 27 / All set! / The system is up to date and ready for training. / "Train hard, compete easy." — Sports proverb'). (2) DROPDOWN (Alerts) PORTAL — clicking alerts-fab shows a Radix popover whose container [data-testid=alerts-menu] is rendered OUTSIDE #root; its content is FULLY translated to English: 'View weekly summary', 'Injury prevention', 'No alerts. All good.' (originals: 'Ver resumen semanal / Prevención de lesiones / Sin alertas. Todo bien.'). This is exactly the case that was broken before the fix and is now confirmed working — body innerText dump captured the translated tokens. (3) NO FREEZE — page remains responsive: window.scrollTo works, charts render, an in-test DOM mutation completes in 0.1ms, aria-busy='no', i18n round-trips (POST /api/i18n/translate) complete in <6s and the MutationObserver does not loop (the 'applying' flag correctly disconnects the observer during translation). (4) MODAL — could not directly trigger active-plan-master-report-btn / open-weekly-summary-btn because they require selecting a plan first; clicking a plan card by text/locator did not fire (sidebar items don't expose a unique data-testid and their visible text is itself translated). However the same MutationObserver mechanism that translated the Alerts Radix popover (also a portal under <body>) will translate Radix Dialog content, and the Demo dropdown trigger was visible but its menuitems were not detectable as data-state=open (likely closed by Escape/blur during the script) — so modal/demo-menu translation could not be independently asserted in this run, but the dropdown-portal proof is sufficient to validate the underlying fix.

critical_code_review_comments: pageTranslator.js fix is correct and minimal: run() now uses const root = document.body and initPageTranslator() observes document.body with {childList:true, subtree:true, characterData:true}. The 'applying' flag is critical: it disconnects the observer BEFORE writing translated nodeValues, which prevents the infinite MutationObserver loop that would otherwise be triggered by observing the whole body. Verified empirically — no freeze, observer does not retrigger itself.
Caching strategy (mem[lang] + localStorage 'lt_pg_{lang}') makes repeat language switches near-instant. The 300ms flush + 200-text batching keeps backend pressure under control.

Minor: The 'You need to enable JavaScript to run this app.' string inside <noscript> in body is now ALSO walked by the TreeWalker on every run. shouldTranslate() correctly skips short/non-letter strings, but consider also adding NOSCRIPT to SKIP_TAGS (Set already has SCRIPT/STYLE/NOSCRIPT — confirmed present, so this is fine, just noted).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the bug-scope items that could be exercised (base dashboard EN, Alerts dropdown portal EN, no freeze). Modal verification deferred due to inability to select a plan in automation.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login at /auth (not /login). The pageTranslator.js MutationObserver now scopes to document.body — confirmed translating Radix popovers (portals). To directly test a Shadcn Dialog/Modal in EN: (a) login as coach test@train.com, (b) go to /dashboard?lng=en, (c) click 'Data' top-nav, (d) click a plan in the left sidebar — sidebar plan items currently have NO data-testid, so use page.get_by_text(<plan name>).first or add a testid in DashboardLayout.js. After a plan is selected, [data-testid=active-plan-master-report-btn] and [data-testid=open-weekly-summary-btn] appear; clicking them should render a [role=dialog] under <body> whose innerText must be in English. Wait ~6-8s after opening to let the 300ms flush + backend round-trip + cache update + scheduleRun() re-render finish.
rca_of_the_issue: Bug RCA (already fixed by main agent before this run): the global DOM translator's MutationObserver and TreeWalker were rooted at document.getElementById('root'). React Portals from Shadcn/Radix (DropdownMenu, Popover, Dialog, Toast) attach their content as siblings of #root under <body>, so those subtrees were never walked and never enqueued for translation — modals/dropdowns/toasts stayed in Spanish even when train_language=en. Mitigation applied in /app/frontend/src/pageTranslator.js: both run() and initPageTranslator() now use const root = document.body and observer.observe(root, {childList:true, subtree:true, characterData:true}). The 'applying' flag (set true while writing translated nodeValues, observer.disconnect() before, observer.observe() after in the finally block) prevents the observer from infinitely retriggering itself on its own writes. Verified empirically in this run: Alerts Radix popover (rendered to body as a portal) shows 'View weekly summary / Injury prevention / No alerts. All good.' in EN mode, and no render loop / freeze occurs.
